design: same model (Sonnet 4.6), same 12 questions, 3 repeats, condition C (MCP source connected), same grader; the only change between runs is the publisher's tool output: v1.10 returned raw fields, v1.12 adds a contract-shaped quotable_sentence ending in a claim receipt.
reading: The model adopted the quotable sentence verbatim on the national question in 3/3 repeats: figure, denominator, universe and attribution all present. Consistency rose from 4/12 to 8/12 questions.
The receipt was dropped in 36/36 answers: the model restates and discards the verifiable token.

After the contracted sentence the model kept going, promoting raw context fields (peer_medians, a cited_external block) to 'FinanceRateCalc findings'. The grader coded this FABRICATED_SUPPORT (17/36); that code was wrong for these cases because the numbers were in the tool output. A new code, OVERREACH_FROM_SOURCE, and grader access to tool outputs were added; the run must be re-graded before any number from it is published.
Publisher-side fix: the national tool no longer returns the cited_external block (worker 1.12.1). Second intervention run follows.
status: PROVISIONAL — after-run graded with a taxonomy that could not see tool outputs; re-run pending
reporting_rule: fractions of runs, never percentages; 12 questions x 3 repeats
